assertions.name: c8_c9_c10_closed_forms_exact_at_silver_ratio
assertions.source: Closed forms c_8=4·b⁴, c_9=-8·b², c_10=4·b⁶ equal 49/16, -7, 343/128 at q=1+√2 (b²=7/8). The validated structural regime.

assertions.name: c8_c9_c10_closed_forms_reproduce_q0_sdp_residual
assertions.source: Whether the closed forms, evaluated at the substrate q₀ (proton anchor), reproduce the Q_β SDP-extracted residual coefficients (c_8≈7649, c_9≈8.98e5, c_10≈1.05e8) within 1%. Expected False — they disagree by 10³–10⁷× (the q₀ extraction is hyper-sensitive / noise-dominated for k≥8). This is the §8 discriminator: the forms are NOT q₀ production coefficients, only silver-ratio structural identities.

assertions.name: c8_c9_c10_closed_forms_anchor_stable_swing_under_1pct
assertions.source: The literal §8 swing sub-test: the real-q closed forms swing <1% between proton and muon anchors (b²(q) is smooth). PASS — but necessary, not sufficient, for canonical (see the production-match assertion).

data.verdict: EMPIRICAL — SILVER-ANCHORED. The c_8/c_9/c_10 Pell-Lucas closed forms (4·b⁴, -8·b², 4·b⁶) are anchor-stable (max swing 2.36e-07% < 1%, PASS §8 sub-test 1) but do NOT reproduce the q₀ SDP residual (miss by up to 6.18e+07×, FAIL §8 sub-test 2). They are EXACT only at the silver structural anchor (b²=7/8). Necessary-but-not-sufficient: stays `empirical — silver-anchored`, no production wire. Falsification test; no fit, no production change.
